description: Reads the registrant list of one webinar: name, email, signup time, attended, watched the replay, purchased, where they came from, and what each one spent. Take it when a host asks who registered or whom to follow up, for example "Who was there, and who bought?" It needs the session id and reads only from the connected site, the one the host approved. It changes nothing. Personal data comes only when the host's licence includes the registrant export; without it the site answers license_required and says which plan brings the feature. With all_webinars set it reads every webinar in one answer. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step. Words hosts use: registrants, leads, participants, who registered, signups

all_webinars.description: Read every webinar of the site in one answer instead of one webinar. Ignored when webinar_id is given.

limit.description: How many registrants to return per webinar, 1-200. Default 50. The site caps at 200 per call and has no offset, so a longer list is only reachable in parts.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when the session already built one.

name: wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants
title: List webinar registrants and leads
